info.name: Baguio PC Parts API
info.description: ITPE101 final project – run top to bottom with the 'Baguio PC Parts – Local' environment after `npm run db:seed`. Contains positive and negative cases with assertions. No secrets are stored here.

exec: pm.test("Error envelope with code EMAIL_TAKEN", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("EMAIL_TAKEN"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code INVALID_CREDENTIALS", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("INVALID_CREDENTIALS"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code VALIDATION_ERROR", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("VALIDATION_ERROR"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test('Sorted by price ascending', () => { const p = j.data.map(x => x.priceCents); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a,b)=>a-b)); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Found', () => pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(0)); if (d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('lastUnitId', d[0].id);
const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('am4BoardId', d[0].id);

pm.test("Error envelope with code NOT_FOUND", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("NOT_FOUND"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code VALIDATION_ERROR", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("VALIDATION_ERROR"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code AUTH_REQUIRED", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("AUTH_REQUIRED"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test('Server computes line total', () => { const i = pm.response.json().data.items[0]; pm.expect(i.lineTotalCents).to.eql(i.unitPriceCents * i.quantity); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code COUPON_EXPIRED", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("COUPON_EXPIRED"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code COUPON_NOT_FOUND", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("COUPON_NOT_FOUND"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('total = subtotal - discount + shipping', () => pm.expect(d.totalCents).to.eql(d.subtotalCents - d.discountCents + d.shippingFeeCents));

pm.test("Error envelope with code IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: 'maria@baguiopcparts.test', password: pm.variables.get('customerPassword') }) } }, (e, r) => { if (!e) pm.collectionVariables.set('customer2Token', r.json().data.token); });

pm.test("Error envelope with code WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test('Ignored or duplicate', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.ignored || d.duplicate).to.be.true; });

pm.test("Error envelope with code ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE"); pm.expect(j.requestId).to.be.a("string"); });

exec: pm.test('Every pick has a DB product id and integer price', () => j.data.picks.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.product.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(p.product.priceCents)).to.be.true; }));
